static_traits.name: Li Anming
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends to confide in, but has not yet fully shared my difficulties
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before, has not received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Good cooperation, clear expression, fairly logical thinking, cautious tone; tending to personalize others' feedback, ignoring positive information

basic_info.main_problem: I am troubled by inadequacy and disappointment triggered by a negative review related to my cooking; these feelings have persisted since receiving that negative feedback, and significantly affect my confidence and mood; I often dwell on this negative comment and ignore positive feedback.
basic_info.core_demands: I need some ways to help me get through this.

special_situations.event: During one food service, all customers except one elderly lady said the dishes were wonderful; that lady gave a negative review
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If even one customer does not like my dishes, it shows I am not good enough/I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to improve cooking skills and strives to satisfy all customers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She does not like my dishes=I failed

special_situations.event: At a banquet, a guest commented the dishes were 'under-seasoned', while other guests gave praise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as a negative comment appears, it proves my ability is inadequate and may destroy my career dream
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pursues perfection in every round of feedback and practices twice as much to improve the dishes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I let them down/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Each time receiving negative feedback or comments on the dishes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative evaluations are more real than positive ones and must be prioritized
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores praise, focuses more on criticism to prevent mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite; positive feedback does not count

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A customer's criticism equals negating me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-examining, trying to find and correct 'mistakes'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This says I am not good enough; I personally am not capable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed (hopes all customers like and praise my cooking)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing I am not good enough, fearing failure and being negated
defense_goal: Maintaining self-worth and security by constantly improving and pleasing everyone

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out my tendency toward 'personalization' or invites me to explore alternative viewpoints
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe rational analysis can hardly change feelings, implicitly experiencing 'my emotions will not be truly understood'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Has a calm, cautious tone, emphasizing reasons and logic, downplaying emotional experience, and avoiding in-depth exploration of inner feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about customers' negative evaluations or recalling specific situations of being criticized
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating customers' preferences as a comprehensive negation of my overall ability and worth
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming and negating wording (e.g. 'I failed'), in a low tone, weakening expressions of self-worth.

manifestations: Decreased enjoyment of cooking after the negative review, Reduced motivation
Treating a single criticism as confirmation of 'I am not good enough', weakening the sense of meaning in career pursuit
outcomes: Over-sensitivity to feedback leading to Interpersonal tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-questioning in sessions, internalizing criticism as Self-denial
Over-sensitive and cautious about others' feedback, worrying that any dissatisfaction means failure

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interprets others' positive feedback as 'they are just being polite'
Inferring others' motives as 'perfunctory/not genuine', thereby negating positive information

positive_force: Positive feedback from most customers and peers exists
Passionate about cooking and has a professional dream of opening a restaurant
Has several close friends who can provide support
negative_force: Self-worth highly depends on external evaluation, strong tendency to please others
Negative cognitive biases: mental filtering, negating the positive, personalization, catastrophizing
Excessive rumination and self-criticism leading to Low mood and Sleep affected
Highly sensitive to negative feedback; work and relationships are disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive rumination on negative evaluations and ignoring positive feedback
antecedent: Receives feedback about dishes, especially negative comments
Seeing guests not yet finished eating or hearing critical remarks at banquets
target_behavior.core_reason: Treating a single negative review as confirmation of self-worth ('I am not good enough'), and maintaining rumination with personalizing, catastrophizing cognition
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the threat of being negated, gaining a sense of control through self-criticism and trying to improve to avoid another negative review
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased confidence, Low mood, Sleep affected; Relationship tension with colleagues and potential clients, reduced career motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Impaired sleep patterns (Difficulty falling asleep/Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: Ruminates at night on the comments after receiving or recalling negative feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative reviews triggering Anxiety and rumination, unable to stop the thoughts
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and avoid making the same mistakes again through repeated review and worrying
target_behavior.consequence: The next day energy declines, mood is worse, work motivation and performance are affected
